sentences.en: In the melanomas, staining was relatively uniform, while in primary acquired melanosis there was cell-to-cell variability in the staining.

sentences.en: Our own studies in London suggest that intracranial melanosis is relatively rare.

sentences.en: We found evidence of intracranial or intraspinal melanosis in around 1 in 14 of these children.

sentences.en: Primary acquired melanosis may lead to the development of melanoma even in blacks.

sentences.en: In chronic cases the eventual effects are anaemia, melanosis, enlargement of the spleen and liver, and general cachexia.
sentences.vi: Trong những trường hợp mãn tính, hậu quả cuối cùng là thiếu máu, melanosis, lá lách và gan to ra, và suy mòn nói chung.

sentences.en: Riehl's melanosis is a pigmented dermatitis that develops over the face and neck, which affects the appearance of patients.
sentences.vi: Riehl's melanosis là một bệnh viêm da sắc tố phát triển trên mặt và cổ, ảnh hưởng đến ngoại hình của bệnh nhân.
